message.content: {"existing":[],"new":[{"name":"REVISES_INTERPRETATION_AFTER_CONTRADICTING_RESULT","definition":"An interpretation or assumption stated in earlier reasoning is abandoned and replaced by a new interpretation after an observation shows that the original interpretation does not hold.","parameters":[{"name":"prior_interpretation","type":"reasoning","description":"The earlier agent text stating the assumption or interpretation about how the task, data, or artifact is structured."},{"name":"contradicting_observation","type":"observation","description":"The observation whose content contradicts the prior interpretation."},{"name":"revised_interpretation","type":"reasoning","description":"The later agent text that acknowledges the contradiction and adopts the replacement interpretation."}],"assertion_conditions":["The prior interpretation commits to a specific expectation about the data, naming, or behavior relevant to the task.","The observation reports a result that is incompatible with that expectation (for example an empty selection or a mismatch).","The revised interpretation explicitly acknowledges the incompatibility and substitutes a different interpretation that the observation supports."],"exclusion_conditions":["The observation is consistent with the prior interpretation, so no revision is needed.","The revision is not connected to the contradicting observation.","The agent changes approach without any identifiable prior interpretation being contradicted."]},{"name":"CORROBORATES_RESULT_WITH_INDEPENDENT_PATH","definition":"A previously obtained result is recomputed through a materially different data-access or implementation path in order to check for agreement, and the second observation reproduces the same value.","parameters":[{"name":"baseline_result","type":"observation","description":"The observation reporting the first computed value produced by the original implementation path."},{"name":"validation_action","type":"action","description":"The action recomputing the same quantity through an alternative path."},{"name":"validation_result","type":"observation","description":"The observation reporting the recomputed value from the alternative path."}],"assertion_conditions":["The baseline observation reports a computed value.","The validation action uses a different loading, access, or implementation path than the one that produced the baseline (for example a different library or interface for the same data).","The validation observation reports the same value for the same quantity as the baseline."],"exclusion_conditions":["The second run repeats the identical code path, so agreement is not informative.","The recomputed quantity or selection differs from the baseline.","The two observations report different values, or no baseline value exists."]},{"name":"CONFIRMS_PERSISTED_OUTPUT_MATCHES_COMPUTED_VALUE","definition":"An action inspects the persisted output artifact, and its observation shows artifact content identical to the value the agent previously computed, confirming that the stored answer reflects the computed result.","parameters":[{"name":"computed_result","type":"observation","description":"The observation reporting the value produced by the computation."},{"name":"inspection_action","type":"action","description":"The action that reads or lists the persisted output artifact."},{"name":"artifact_observation","type":"observation","description":"The observation showing the content of the persisted output artifact."}],"assertion_conditions":["The computed result observation reports a specific value.","The inspection action targets the file or artifact where the answer was written.","The artifact observation shows content whose value is identical to the reported computed value, including correct formatting requirements."],"exclusion_conditions":["The artifact content is missing, empty, or differs from the computed value.","The inspection action does not read the output artifact.","No previously computed value exists to compare against.","Numerical agreement is claimed but not visible in either observation."]},{"name":"CONCLUDES_WITH_FINAL_ANSWER","definition":"The reasoning states the definitive final answer value, connects it to the produced artifact and the evidence chain, and asserts that the task is complete.","parameters":[{"name":"conclusion_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The agent text presenting the final value together with its justification and a completion claim."}],"assertion_conditions":["The reasoning presents a specific final value as the answer.","The reasoning links that value to the produced output artifact and to at least one supporting observation.","The reasoning explicitly states that the task is complete or finished."],"exclusion_conditions":["The reasoning is intermediate, exploratory, or tentative about the value.","No final value is stated.","The reasoning only describes steps without asserting completion."]}],"uncertain":[{"name":"SPECIFIES_EXECUTION_PROCEDURE","definition":"The reasoning lays out an ordered, concrete procedure of operations—identifying the inputs to obtain, the transformations to apply, and the aggregate or output to produce—that the agent intends to execute in order to accomplish the task.","parameters":[{"name":"procedure_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The agent text enumerating the ordered steps, inputs, transformations, and expected output of the intended procedure."}],"assertion_conditions":["The reasoning enumerates two or more ordered steps that connect identifiable inputs to a final computed output.","The steps describe what the agent will do next, including how intermediate data will be filtered, processed, or aggregated."],"exclusion_conditions":["The reasoning only reports or summarizes actions already completed.","The reasoning only restates the task without specifying an ordered procedure.","Only a single undifferentiated action is named with no sequence of operations."]},{"name":"DIAGNOSES_DEVIATION_CAUSE","definition":"The reasoning attributes an unexpected or failing observed result to a specific cause that explains why the output differed from the agent's prior expectation, rather than merely reporting the failure.","parameters":[{"name":"diagnostic_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The agent text that names the cause of the unexpected or failing result and explains the discrepancy."}],"assertion_conditions":["The reasoning refers to an unexpected, empty, or erroneous outcome.","The reasoning identifies a specific cause (for example a naming mismatch, a category value that differs from the assumed one, or an unsupported access path) responsible for that outcome.","The stated cause explains the difference between the expected and the observed result."],"exclusion_conditions":["The reasoning merely repeats or quotes the error output without attributing a cause.","The reasoning retries the operation without any explanation of why the previous attempt failed.","No deviation from expectation is identified."]},{"name":"MAPS_AMBIGUOUS_TERM_TO_DOCUMENTED_CATEGORIES","definition":"The reasoning resolves an ambiguous task term that has no literal counterpart in the data by mapping it onto a group of concrete categories declared in reference documentation captured in an observation.","parameters":[{"name":"mapping_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The agent text that recognizes the term is ambiguous or unmatched and adopts a documented category grouping in place of a literal value."},{"name":"documentation_observation","type":"observation","description":"The observation containing reference documentation that declares which concrete categories or sources belong to the ambiguous grouping."}],"assertion_conditions":["The reasoning states that the term used by the task does not appear literally in the data or is otherwise ambiguous.","The documentation observation contains an explicit grouping, source listing, or taxonomy that associates the ambiguous term with concrete categories.","The reasoning cites that documented grouping and enumerates the concrete member categories it will use."],"exclusion_conditions":["The reasoning selects a value by guess or convention without documentation support.","A literal value matching the task term exists in the data.","The documentation observation does not address the term being resolved."]},{"name":"SELECTS_SOURCE_BY_REQUIRED_FIELDS","definition":"The reasoning chooses among alternative data sources, subsets, or representations on the grounds that only one of them contains the fields required to answer the task.","parameters":[{"name":"selection_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The agent text that compares candidate sources or subsets and justifies the chosen one by the fields it provides."},{"name":"structure_observation","type":"observation","description":"The observation describing the fields or columns available in each candidate source or subset."}],"assertion_conditions":["At least two candidate sources, subsets, or representations are identifiable.","The structure observation lists distinct field sets for the candidates.","The reasoning justifies the selected candidate by the presence of the specific fields the task needs and rejects an alternative for lacking them."],"exclusion_conditions":["Only one source is available, so no selection is required.","The selection is justified by convenience, size, or default behavior rather than by required fields.","The structure observation does not distinguish the candidates' fields."]},{"name":"PROBES_MEASUREMENT_CONVENTION_TO_RESOLVE_AMBIGUITY","definition":"An action is deliberately executed to determine how a counting, encoding, or measurement convention behaves, because competing conventions would yield different result values, and the observation settles which convention the reported value reflects.","parameters":[{"name":"ambiguity_reasoning","type":"reasoning","description":"The agent text identifying alternative conventions whose differences would change the resulting value."},{"name":"probe_action","type":"action","description":"The action that exercises the convention on a controlled input to reveal its behavior."},{"name":"probe_observation","type":"observation","description":"The observation reporting the convention's behavior on the controlled input."}],"assertion_conditions":["The reasoning states that two or more conventions exist and that they would produce different result values.","The probe action targets the convention behavior itself rather than computing the final answer.","The observation reports the actual behavior (for example whether extra elements are added), which determines which convention applies."],"exclusion_conditions":["The action computes the final answer directly instead of testing convention behavior.","The observation does not reveal anything about the convention under question.","The identified alternative would not change the resulting value."]}]}

new.name: REVISES_INTERPRETATION_AFTER_CONTRADICTING_RESULT
new.definition: An interpretation or assumption stated in earlier reasoning is abandoned and replaced by a new interpretation after an observation shows that the original interpretation does not hold.

parameters.name: prior_interpretation
parameters.description: The earlier agent text stating the assumption or interpretation about how the task, data, or artifact is structured.

parameters.name: contradicting_observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content contradicts the prior interpretation.

parameters.name: revised_interpretation
parameters.description: The later agent text that acknowledges the contradiction and adopts the replacement interpretation.

assertion_conditions: The prior interpretation commits to a specific expectation about the data, naming, or behavior relevant to the task.
The observation reports a result that is incompatible with that expectation (for example an empty selection or a mismatch).
The revised interpretation explicitly acknowledges the incompatibility and substitutes a different interpretation that the observation supports.
exclusion_conditions: The observation is consistent with the prior interpretation, so no revision is needed.
The revision is not connected to the contradicting observation.
The agent changes approach without any identifiable prior interpretation being contradicted.

new.name: CORROBORATES_RESULT_WITH_INDEPENDENT_PATH
new.definition: A previously obtained result is recomputed through a materially different data-access or implementation path in order to check for agreement, and the second observation reproduces the same value.

parameters.name: baseline_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the first computed value produced by the original implementation path.

parameters.name: validation_action
parameters.description: The action recomputing the same quantity through an alternative path.

parameters.name: validation_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the recomputed value from the alternative path.

assertion_conditions: The baseline observation reports a computed value.
The validation action uses a different loading, access, or implementation path than the one that produced the baseline (for example a different library or interface for the same data).
The validation observation reports the same value for the same quantity as the baseline.
exclusion_conditions: The second run repeats the identical code path, so agreement is not informative.
The recomputed quantity or selection differs from the baseline.
The two observations report different values, or no baseline value exists.

new.name: CONFIRMS_PERSISTED_OUTPUT_MATCHES_COMPUTED_VALUE
new.definition: An action inspects the persisted output artifact, and its observation shows artifact content identical to the value the agent previously computed, confirming that the stored answer reflects the computed result.

parameters.name: computed_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the value produced by the computation.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: The action that reads or lists the persisted output artifact.

parameters.name: artifact_observation
parameters.description: The observation showing the content of the persisted output artifact.

assertion_conditions: The computed result observation reports a specific value.
The inspection action targets the file or artifact where the answer was written.
The artifact observation shows content whose value is identical to the reported computed value, including correct formatting requirements.
exclusion_conditions: The artifact content is missing, empty, or differs from the computed value.
The inspection action does not read the output artifact.
No previously computed value exists to compare against.
Numerical agreement is claimed but not visible in either observation.

new.name: CONCLUDES_WITH_FINAL_ANSWER
new.definition: The reasoning states the definitive final answer value, connects it to the produced artifact and the evidence chain, and asserts that the task is complete.

parameters.name: conclusion_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text presenting the final value together with its justification and a completion claim.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning presents a specific final value as the answer.
The reasoning links that value to the produced output artifact and to at least one supporting observation.
The reasoning explicitly states that the task is complete or finished.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning is intermediate, exploratory, or tentative about the value.
No final value is stated.
The reasoning only describes steps without asserting completion.

uncertain.name: SPECIFIES_EXECUTION_PROCEDURE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning lays out an ordered, concrete procedure of operations—identifying the inputs to obtain, the transformations to apply, and the aggregate or output to produce—that the agent intends to execute in order to accomplish the task.

parameters.name: procedure_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating the ordered steps, inputs, transformations, and expected output of the intended procedure.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates two or more ordered steps that connect identifiable inputs to a final computed output.
The steps describe what the agent will do next, including how intermediate data will be filtered, processed, or aggregated.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports or summarizes actions already completed.
The reasoning only restates the task without specifying an ordered procedure.
Only a single undifferentiated action is named with no sequence of operations.

uncertain.name: DIAGNOSES_DEVIATION_CAUSE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning attributes an unexpected or failing observed result to a specific cause that explains why the output differed from the agent's prior expectation, rather than merely reporting the failure.

parameters.name: diagnostic_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that names the cause of the unexpected or failing result and explains the discrepancy.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to an unexpected, empty, or erroneous outcome.
The reasoning identifies a specific cause (for example a naming mismatch, a category value that differs from the assumed one, or an unsupported access path) responsible for that outcome.
The stated cause explains the difference between the expected and the observed result.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats or quotes the error output without attributing a cause.
The reasoning retries the operation without any explanation of why the previous attempt failed.
No deviation from expectation is identified.

uncertain.name: MAPS_AMBIGUOUS_TERM_TO_DOCUMENTED_CATEGORIES
uncertain.definition: The reasoning resolves an ambiguous task term that has no literal counterpart in the data by mapping it onto a group of concrete categories declared in reference documentation captured in an observation.

parameters.name: mapping_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that recognizes the term is ambiguous or unmatched and adopts a documented category grouping in place of a literal value.

parameters.name: documentation_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing reference documentation that declares which concrete categories or sources belong to the ambiguous grouping.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that the term used by the task does not appear literally in the data or is otherwise ambiguous.
The documentation observation contains an explicit grouping, source listing, or taxonomy that associates the ambiguous term with concrete categories.
The reasoning cites that documented grouping and enumerates the concrete member categories it will use.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning selects a value by guess or convention without documentation support.
A literal value matching the task term exists in the data.
The documentation observation does not address the term being resolved.

uncertain.name: SELECTS_SOURCE_BY_REQUIRED_FIELDS
uncertain.definition: The reasoning chooses among alternative data sources, subsets, or representations on the grounds that only one of them contains the fields required to answer the task.

parameters.name: selection_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that compares candidate sources or subsets and justifies the chosen one by the fields it provides.

parameters.name: structure_observation
parameters.description: The observation describing the fields or columns available in each candidate source or subset.

assertion_conditions: At least two candidate sources, subsets, or representations are identifiable.
The structure observation lists distinct field sets for the candidates.
The reasoning justifies the selected candidate by the presence of the specific fields the task needs and rejects an alternative for lacking them.
exclusion_conditions: Only one source is available, so no selection is required.
The selection is justified by convenience, size, or default behavior rather than by required fields.
The structure observation does not distinguish the candidates' fields.

uncertain.name: PROBES_MEASUREMENT_CONVENTION_TO_RESOLVE_AMBIGUITY
uncertain.definition: An action is deliberately executed to determine how a counting, encoding, or measurement convention behaves, because competing conventions would yield different result values, and the observation settles which convention the reported value reflects.

parameters.name: ambiguity_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying alternative conventions whose differences would change the resulting value.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action that exercises the convention on a controlled input to reveal its behavior.

parameters.name: probe_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the convention's behavior on the controlled input.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that two or more conventions exist and that they would produce different result values.
The probe action targets the convention behavior itself rather than computing the final answer.
The observation reports the actual behavior (for example whether extra elements are added), which determines which convention applies.
exclusion_conditions: The action computes the final answer directly instead of testing convention behavior.
The observation does not reveal anything about the convention under question.
The identified alternative would not change the resulting value.
